sql: SELECT pm.match_id, pm.player_slot, pm.hero_id, pm.lane_role, pm.is_roaming, pm.net_worth, pm.gold_t[11] AS gold_10, pm.gold_t[16] AS gold_15, pm.gold_t[21] AS gold_20, pm.gold_t[31] AS gold_30, pm.deaths, -(pm.gold_reasons->>'1')::int AS death_gold, (pm.life_state->>'2')::int AS dead_s, ARRAY(SELECT concat(k->>'time', ':', replace(k->>'key', 'npc_dota_hero_', '')) FROM unnest(pm.kills_log) k WHERE k->>'key' LIKE 'npc_dota_hero_%') AS kills, ARRAY(SELECT (b->>'time')::int FROM unnest(pm.buyback_log) b) AS buybacks, pm.runes FROM player_matches pm WHERE pm.match_id IN (SELECT m.match_id FROM matches m JOIN match_patch mp USING (match_id) WHERE mp.patch = '7.41' AND m.radiant_gold_adv IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m.match_id DESC LIMIT 150)
